steps.text: You have everything a manager has, this dashboard included, plus three decisions that are yours alone: the modules the community uses, who runs it with you, and its legal details.
steps.title: You are an administrator

steps.text: As an administrator, you keep the managers' **"Management"** section. Its **"Users"** page is where you choose who runs the community with you.
steps.title: The "Management" section

steps.text: Tap the **menu icon ☰** to open the navigation.
As an administrator, you keep the managers' **"Management"** section. Its **"Users"** page is where you choose who runs the community with you.
steps.title: The "Management" section

steps.text: Only an administrator can bring in a manager: **"Invite a manager"** sends them an invitation by email, which they accept from their invitations.
steps.title: Invite a manager

steps.text: **"View pending invitations"** shows who has not answered yet. In the list, you alone can change a user's role — member, manager or administrator — or remove them from the community.
steps.title: Invitations and roles

steps.text: The **"Community"** section leads to the dashboard, the community info and its annex services. Its **"Community info"** page holds the legal details only you can change.
steps.title: The "Community" section

steps.text: Tap the **menu icon ☰** to open the navigation.
The **"Community"** section leads to the dashboard, the community info and its annex services. Its **"Community info"** page holds the legal details only you can change.
steps.title: The "Community" section

steps.text: In the menu's **"Community"** section, tap **"Community info"**.
steps.title: The community info

steps.text: Members and managers read this information; only you can change it. **"Edit"** opens the name, description, address, company number and IBAN — what then appears on invoices and official documents.
steps.title: The legal details
